items.prompt: Can I try on this jacket?
items.explanation: "Try on" clothes is przymierzyć, + accusative: tę kurtkę.
optionNotes: The object needs the accusative: tę kurtkę.

items.explanation: Spodnie is plural only, so the verb is plural: są.
optionNotes: Jest is singular; spodnie is a plural word.
Mieć does not describe here; use być.

items.prompt: What size do you wear? (formal, to a woman)
items.explanation: Polish says "which size do you wear": Jaki rozmiar pani nosi?
optionNotes: A copy of "what size are you"; Polish uses nosić.
Rozmiar is masculine, so jaki (Jaki jest pani rozmiar? is fine); jaka is feminine.

items.explanation: Colours are adjectives and agree with the noun: kurtkę (accusative feminine) → czarną.
optionNotes: Feminine nominative; the object needs the accusative.
